text: Which one of the following is NOT equivalent to p ↔ q?
solution: p↔q ≡ (p→q)∧(q→p) ≡ (¬p∨q)∧(¬q∨p), which is (A); it equals (B) since ¬q∨p ≡ q→p; and it equals the XNOR form (D). Option (C) is (p∧¬q)∨(¬p∧q) = p⊕q, the negation of p↔q.
source_label: GATE Overflow question page - GATE CSE 2015 Set 1 Q.14 with community solutions
answer_evidence: So, answer C is not equivanet to $p \iff q$ and is the answer.
